title: Ostium sdk getting better now
author: Unusual-Back4404
selftext:
been runnin the same setup on ostium sdk for a while now . ig around 6-7 weeks . can notice fills coming back cleaner and latency feels tighter than it did a few weeks ago

could be infra change on their endd .could be something else entirely but couldnt figured out but i can say is the sessions that used problem are not the ones bothering me now .

something shifted and its showing up consistently enough that it is not a one off. any1 seeing the same thing or if it is just specific to certain asset classes??
